newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst optimistic for the current year.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst optimistic for the current year.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG said on Wednesday that it expected to have another successful year in 1997 despite anticipated restructuring charges.
The group said on Tuesday that its 1996 pre-tax profit surged to 5.28 billion marks against 4.091 billion marks the previous year.
In a statement Hoechst said it forecast profits for its pharmaceutical and agricultural businesses in 1997, as well as for the industrial business of its affiliates Messer and Herberts.
"The company is anticipating a slight upturn in basic chemicals, fibres and plastics, although the operating result will be burdened by restructuring charges in 1997," the group said.
Additionally Hoechst said it anticipates an increase in underlying operating profit in a generally favourable economic climate.
